01 The Paper Trail
305,412

That's how many messages we've sent each other since January 2023. 855,285 words, if anyone's counting — call it nine and a half novels, unpublished, deeply unhinged, not suitable for a general audience.

I talk more than you do, for the record — 179,263 to your 126,149. Somebody had to carry this friendship's word count and it wasn't going to be you.
